create_enn_with_additive_prior: create an ENN with additive prior function applied to outputs using EnnNoStateWithAdditivePrior
build_enn_with_prior_state: build an ENN with additive prior applied to outputs using EnnWithAdditivePrior class
convert_enn_to_prior_fn: convert an ENN to a prior function with fixed parameters using convert_enn_to_prior_fn
generate_random_feature_gp: generate a random features GP realization using make_random_feat_gp with configurable gamma and scale
create_random_mlp_prior: create a prior function based on a random MLP using get_random_mlp_with_index
